Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, a. the finger palette including: i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion; b. the method including the steps of: i. securing the finger palette to a finger; ii. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and iii. transferring at least a portion of the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein: a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity and being no greater than a third quantity that is defined as the amount of cosmetic product remaining on the surface portion after the first quantity has been deposited.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without any fixed protrusions extending therefrom that would inhibit cleaning of the surface portion.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar across its entirety.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion in a manner that allows for easy removal and replacement of the finger palette during use.
